title: Vault guard mechanic
evidence: Rollout 0 (seed 5), turns 15-23: guard appeared in vault, asked name — player spent 6 calls typing 'Agent' one char at a time, then 2 calls dropping gold. Turn 41: player re-picked gold, guard said 'So be it, rogue!' and went hostile. Turns 42-43: guard killed player with thrown daggers.
expected_effect: Next player types a short name (1-2 chars + ENTER) to save calls, drops gold when asked, and never re-picks it — avoiding guard hostility and death.

title: explore_level near peaceful NPCs
evidence: Rollout 0 (seed 5), turns 31-38: np_explore_level repeatedly tried to path through the vault guard, triggering 'Really attack the guard? [yn] (n)' prompt each time. 8 calls wasted in this loop before player accidentally answered 'y'.
expected_effect: Player uses np_move_to to manually walk away from guards/peaceful NPCs before calling explore, avoiding prompt loops.

title: Answer prompts, don't repeat skills
evidence: Rollout 0 (seed 5), turns 31-38: when 'Really attack?' prompt was open, player alternated between np_press_key('n') and np_explore_level — each explore re-triggered the same prompt. Also turns 32-33: 'n' then ENTER didn't dismiss; game stayed frozen. 8 calls consumed with no progress.
expected_effect: Player recognizes frozen-prompt state and answers only with np_press_key, never re-calling explore/move until the prompt is cleared.

title: Prioritize descent over exploration
evidence: Rollout 0 (seed 5), turns 7-14: 8 calls spent on np_explore_level, each interrupting for trivial items (pick-axe turn 8, potion turn 9, cream pie turn 10, gold turn 12). Only reached dlvl 2 in 44 total calls. Turns 0-4 by contrast: 5 calls to descend dlvl 1→2 efficiently.
expected_effect: Player heads directly for stairs using request_map+move_to instead of full exploration, preserving budget for deeper descent.

title: Descend one level
evidence: Rollout 0 (seed 5), turns 0-4: efficient descent pattern — request_map (found '>' at (61,15)), np_move_to failed on closed door, np_kick opened it, np_move_to reached stairs, np_press_key('>') descended. 5 calls for one level.
expected_effect: Player applies this proven sequence each level, kicking closed doors that block the path to stairs.
